Class Items

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.item.Items
public final class Items extends Object
Minecraft items as resources (ARCHITECTURE.md §23.4). There is one resource type, ITEM; the concrete item is its DATA component, so items added after MachineEngine started (CraftEngine items load later) work too. Amounts are item counts.

MachineEngine registers these itself. The Paper module converts to and from ItemStacks.
